title: Your Voice, Not Ours
tagline: AI doesn't have to make everyone sound the same. HABOS learns your writing style, your tone, your quirks — so every draft, every email, every reply sounds like you. Not a corporate chatbot. You.

section1.heading: The keyboard is a bottleneck
section1.body1: Typing was invented for typewriters. Tapping was invented for phones. Neither was invented for running a business. When a field technician finishes a job, the last thing they want to do is sit in the van filling out four different apps. When a founder has an idea at 11pm, they don't want to open a laptop and navigate three menus.
section1.body2: Voice is the fastest, lowest-friction way to capture intent. You speak at roughly 150 words per minute. You type at 40. That's not a small difference — it's a 4x multiplier on input speed, and the gap between having an idea and losing it.

section2.heading: Not transcription. Understanding.
section2.body1: Most voice products transcribe your speech into text and stop there. You get a wall of words and the same amount of work ahead of you. HABOS does something fundamentally different.
section2.body2: The Smart Router takes a single voice recording and classifies every sentence into intents — tasks, calendar events, CRM updates, inventory notes, messages, research requests — then extracts structured data for each one and routes them to the right destination. All in under three seconds.

section3.heading: Every surface speaks
section3.intro: Voice isn't limited to one feature. It's a first-class input across the entire platform:

items.label: iPhone & Apple Watch
items.body: record voice notes on the go, get action cards on your wrist, confirm with a tap or a word

items.label: Realtime conversation
items.body: bidirectional voice with the AI assistant, sub-300ms speech-to-speech latency

items.label: Voice email
items.body: answer your entire inbox by speaking: "Reply to Lars, tell him I'm available Thursday"

items.label: Voice reports
items.body: fill structured forms by conversation instead of clicking through fields

items.label: Meeting transcription
items.body: live notes, action items, and suggested questions, all generated in real-time

section4.heading: Context-aware routing
section4.body1: The Smart Router is duration-aware. A 2-minute recording mentioning "meeting" is classified as scheduling a meeting. A 15-minute recording mentioning "meeting" is classified as meeting notes. The system understands that short recordings are commands and long recordings are content.
section4.body2: It also maps word-level indices — so the mobile UI can highlight exactly which words became which actions. Tap "schedule a site visit next Tuesday at 2pm" in the transcript and it opens the calendar event that was created from those exact words.

quote: "The closest analog is a human executive assistant who listens to your rambling update and creates four different items in four different systems. Except HABOS does it in under three seconds."
